title: DivineCows
description: This is a paper/spigot plugin that punishes a player if he/she kills a cow.
body:
**🐄 Cow Protector** – Zero Tolerance for Cow Killing

Cow Protector is a lightweight Paper and Spigot plugin that strictly enforces a no cow killing rule on your server.

If a player kills a cow, the plugin automatically applies escalating punishment. There are no permission bypasses and even operators are not exempt.

How it works

First offense
When a player kills a cow for the first time, they are instantly kicked from the server.

Kick message:
"Killing a cow is not allowed in this server, this is your last warning"

The server also broadcasts:
"(Player) has killed a cow and has been kicked, this is their last warning"

This acts as the final warning.

Second offense
If the same player kills a cow again, they are permanently banned.

Ban message:
"You have been banned from the server. Reason: killed a cow even after warning"

The server broadcasts:
"(Player) killed a cow again and has been banned"

There are no third chances.

Features

Works on the latest Paper and Spigot versions
Tracks offenses per player
Automatically kicks on first offense
Automatically permanently bans on second offense
Broadcasts punishments to the entire server
No permission bypass
Operators are not exempt
Lightweight and optimized

Perfect for

Hardcore SMP servers
Roleplay servers
Economy based survival
Challenge or meme servers
Any server where cows must be protected

Cow Protector keeps enforcement simple and automatic. If someone breaks the rule, the system handles it instantly.

Protect your cows. Enforce your rules.
